original_test_intent: Verify correctable LCRC handling on every required OCP slot at both the OCP endpoint and its upstream root port, while preserving link width/speed, driver/device operation and network/management reachability.
original_method: Inventory fitted OCP modules, firmware/drivers/interfaces and physical slot-to-endpoint/root-port BDF topology; identify whether any tested interface carries management, storage or cluster traffic; preserve AER/link counters and active service state; apply approved BIOS deltas; inject one endpoint LCRC CE and separately one root-port CE for a mapped slot; correlate exact AER source and counter deltas; verify link/device/interface recovery; restore settings and repeat only for separately approved slots.
manual_activity: The FAE maps each physical OCP module to endpoint/root port, validates service/management dependencies, executes one CE target at a time and owns link/interface recovery and BIOS/HDT restoration.
required_inputs: Physical OCP slot/module PN/FW/driver to endpoint and upstream root-port BDF map
Required slot 1~N population and whether generic PCIe row 55 overlaps or differs
Interface/bond/VLAN/route/RDMA/storage/cluster mapping and independent OOB management path
AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and proof errortype 0 produces LCRC CE at endpoint versus root port
Exact AER Correctable Error Status/Root Error Status source ID/counter oracle and timeout
Approved OS version replacing ambiguous RHEL 2022, aborts, link/device recovery and BIOS restoration
safety_requirements: Use OOB control independent of the injected OCP interface and quiesce affected production traffic
Never copy BDFs; re-enumerate and correlate physical slot/serial plus upstream path immediately before injection
One endpoint or root-port CE at a time; capture AER/link counters before/after
Abort on wrong source, UCE/fatal escalation, link retrain/degrade, driver reset, packet loss beyond limit or management-path impact
No automatic retry; verify interfaces/services and restore severity/SyncFlood/AER/HDT settings
agent_execution_scope: Validate OCP topology, service dependencies, package provenance, CE/LCRC oracle and recovery
Collect read-only PCIe config/AER, link, driver, interface, OS/BMC and service-health evidence
Do not choose BDF/interface, change BIOS/HDT, inject, reset/rebind/retry, disrupt service or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve distinct OCP coverage and per-slot endpoint/root-port targets
Approve service isolation, tool semantics and event oracle

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic dmesg/rasdaemon may show PCIe CE but cannot prove OCP physical slot, endpoint versus root port or service continuity; memory-health wording is inapplicable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Substitute only topology-verified BDFs for each approved OCP path, inject errortype-0 CE separately at endpoint and upstream port, and correlate source ID plus link/interface health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The two literal BDF commands, errortype 0, LCRC note, BIOS settings, OCP slot 1~N and 30/60 minutes remain preserved as source examples requiring target validation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an OCP-specific physical-to-BDF-to-interface matrix and run separately attributable endpoint/root-port LCRC CE checkpoints with service continuity evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds OCP identity, per-slot iteration, network/storage dependency analysis, exact AER fields, OOB recovery and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The same BDF pair used by a generic PCIe case cannot prove OCP slot 1~N unless physical OCP mapping and distinct coverage are documented.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong BDF or affected interface can break management, storage or cluster connectivity even when the injected error is nominally correctable.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The OCP slot 1~N case reuses the same single hardcoded BDF pair and procedure as the adjacent generic PCIe baseline without proving those devices are OCP or defining all-slot iteration. OCP interfaces and management/service dependencies are absent, timeout is undefined, RHEL 2022 is ambiguous, and DeepSeek carries memory-specific text.

blocked_analysis.analysis: OCP endpoint/root-port CE intent is clear. Engineering can provide topology, distinct coverage and service constraints, so static review completes while execution is gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 56 Wistron-System RAS-00776-V003: provide physical OCP slot/module/serial/FW/driver-to-endpoint/root-port BDF and interface/service mapping for slot 1~N; explain distinct coverage versus baseline PCIe row 55; approve exact supported OS, AMD tool/spec provenance and errortype=0 LCRC semantics, endpoint/root-port AER source/status/counter oracle, timeout, traffic/management isolation, aborts, recovery and BIOS/HDT restoration.

review_improvement: Makes OCP physical and service identity central, preventing a generic hardcoded PCIe pair and memory-oriented log text from being counted as all OCP-slot LCRC coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: OCP is a form factor and platform role, not a property encoded in a BDF. The same BDF can represent different devices across configurations, and an OCP NIC may carry the control connection or storage traffic. Therefore source attribution requires the physical slot and upstream bridge path plus the associated interfaces. A correctable LCRC should produce a bounded AER counter/status change without persistent link or service degradation; tool PASS alone cannot prove either target or containment.
